gloss: first class; first place; first prize

definitions.gloss: first class; first place; first prize; top grade
definitions.explanation: The highest grade, rank, or prize among several levels. Used for prizes, travel classes, and ranks.

examples.japanese: かけっこ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一等|いっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took first place in the foot race.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{客船|きゃくせん}→客船：16792_kyakusen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一等|いっとう}{船室|せんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This passenger ship has first-class cabins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一等|いっとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飛|と}び{上|あ}がって→飛び上がる：06345_tobiagaru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: He won first prize in the lottery and jumped for joy.

notes:
Indicates the top grade, rank, or prize among several levels. Used for prizes, travel classes, and military ranks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一等|いっとう}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: first prize
- {一等|いっとう}{席|せき}: first-class seat
- {一等|いっとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to win first prize

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧: first place — a ranking position in standings or results
- {一級|いっきゅう}: first grade — used for qualifications and skill levels
